title: MaceSmashShieldBypass
description: A plugin that allows a mace's smash attack to go through a blocking shield, similar to Bedrock edition.
body:
A plugin that allows a mace's smash attack to go through a blocking shield, similar to Bedrock edition.

It's what you'd expect, a mace smash attack will damage the targetted enemy regardless if they have their shield up or not as long as you make your hit.

This plugin might work on other versions too, I have not tested that so no promises made!
